name: Machinegun Joe vs The Mafia
summary: Machinegun Joe vs The Mafia is an action maze like shooter game set in the city in stage 1 and in the sewers in stage 2 where you play as Machinegun Joe whose job is to shoot the Mafia that roams and drives around the area. The black ones drop 100 points of moneybags, the drivers drop 200 points of moneybags, and the red ones drop 300 points of moneybags. After disposing of the Mafia, you move on to the next stage but be aware because black ones can shoot one at a time and drivers shoot more than once, and the red ones can throw explosive red barrels that you can shoot. If any of the enemies hit, you then one of your three lives will be lost but if all are gone at either 1 or 0 lives (depending on which version you're playing) then the barrels that spell out game over will be shot and explode.
